startingCard.title: Iran–Iraq War begins
startingCard.subtitle: Conflict
startingCard.fact: The Iran–Iraq War began with the Iraqi invasion of Iran in September 1980.

cards.title: United States Declaration of Independence is proclaimed
cards.subtitle: Declaration of independence
cards.fact: The Declaration of Independence, formally The unanimous Declaration of the thirteen united States of America in the original printing, is the founding document of the United States.

cards.title: Air Transat is founded
cards.subtitle: Airline
cards.fact: Air Transat is a Canadian airline headquartered in Montreal, Quebec.

cards.title: ‘State Anthem of the Soviet Union’ dates to
cards.subtitle: National anthem
cards.fact: The State Anthem of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics was the national anthem of the Soviet Union and the regional anthem of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic from 1944 to 1991, replacing "The Internationale".

cards.title: José Saramago dies
cards.subtitle: Portuguese novelist
cards.fact: José de Sousa Saramago was a Portuguese writer.

cards.title: ‘Mulholland Drive’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by David Lynch
cards.fact: Mulholland Drive is a 2001 mystery film written and directed by David Lynch.

cards.title: Paul the Apostle dies
cards.subtitle: Early Christian apostle and missionary
cards.fact: Paul, commonly known as Paul the Apostle or Saint Paul, was a Christian apostle who spread the teachings of Jesus in the first-century AD.

cards.title: ‘Poor Things’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Yorgos Lanthimos
cards.fact: Poor Things is a 2023 film directed by Yorgos Lanthimos and written by Tony McNamara, based on the 1992 novel by Alasdair Gray.

cards.title: Mandalay Palace is completed
cards.subtitle: Reconstruction of the royal palace of the last Burmese monarchy
cards.fact: The Mandalay Palace, located in Mandalay, Myanmar, is the last royal palace of the last Burmese monarchy.

cards.title: ‘Sense8’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American science fiction television series
cards.fact: Sense8 is an American science fiction drama television series created by Lana and Lilly Wachowski and J.

cards.title: ‘Lego Harry Potter: Years 5–7’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Traveller's Tales
cards.fact: Lego Harry Potter: Years 5–7 is an action-adventure game developed by Traveller's Tales and published by Warner Bros.

cards.title: B. R. Ambedkar dies
cards.subtitle: Indian polymath, philosopher, and social reformer
cards.fact: Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, economist, social reformer and politician who chaired the committee that drafted the Constitution of India based on the debates of the Constituent Assembly of India and the first draft of Sir Benegal Narsing Rau.

cards.title: Royal Palace of Olite is completed
cards.subtitle: Monument
cards.fact: The Palace of the Kings of Navarre of Olite or Royal Palace of Olite is a castle-palace in the town of Olite, in Navarre, Spain.

cards.title: ‘Battle Angel Alita’ begins
cards.subtitle: Japanese manga series
cards.fact: Battle Angel Alita, known in Japan as Gunnm, is a Japanese cyberpunk manga series created by Yukito Kishiro and originally published in Shueisha's Business Jump magazine from 1990 to 1995.

cards.title: VFW VAK 191B first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Vereinigte Flugtechnische Werke
cards.fact: The VFW VAK 191B was an experimental German vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) strike fighter of the early 1970s.

cards.title: Lok Bhavan is completed
cards.subtitle: Official residence of the Governor of West Bengal
cards.fact: Raj Bhavan, officially known as Lok Bhavan and formerly as Government House (1803–1950) is the official residence of the Governor of West Bengal, R.

cards.title: Al-Mu'tamid becomes Abbasid caliph
cards.fact: Abu’l-ʿAbbās Aḥmad ibn Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Hārūn al-Muʿtamid ʿalā’Llāh, better known by his regnal name al-Muʿtamid ʿalā 'llāh, was the caliph of the Abbasid Caliphate from 870 to 892.

cards.title: Templo Mayor is completed
cards.subtitle: Main Temple of Tenochtitlan
cards.fact: The Templo Mayor was the main temple of the Mexica people in their capital city of Tenōchtitlan, which is now Mexico City.

cards.title: Suez Crisis begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Suez Crisis, also known as the second Arab–Israeli war, the Tripartite Aggression in the Arab world and the Sinai War in Israel, was a British–French–Israeli invasion of Egypt in 1956.

cards.title: Castle of San Sebastián is completed
cards.subtitle: Cultural property in Cádiz, Spain
cards.fact: The Castle of San Sebastián is a fortress located in Cádiz, Spain, at the end of La Caleta beach on a small island separated from the main city.

cards.title: ‘Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Konami
cards.fact: Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake is a 1990 action-adventure stealth game developed and published by Konami for the MSX2.

cards.title: Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Skunk Works
cards.fact: The Lockheed SR-71 "Blackbird" is a retired long-range, high-altitude, Mach 3+ strategic reconnaissance aircraft that was developed and manufactured by the American aerospace company Lockheed Corporation.

cards.title: Gloster Meteor first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Gloster Aircraft Company
cards.fact: The Gloster Meteor was the first British jet fighter and the Allies' only jet aircraft to engage in combat operations during the Second World War.

cards.title: East–West MRT line opens
cards.subtitle: Rail line in Singapore
cards.fact: The East–West Line (EWL) is a high-capacity Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) line operated by SMRT in Singapore, running from Pasir Ris station in the east to Tuas Link station in the west, with an additional branch between Changi Airport and Tanah Merah stations.

cards.title: Russian Empire is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Russian Empire spanned most of northern Eurasia from its establishment in November 1721 until the proclamation of the Russian Republic in September 1917.

cards.title: ‘Resident Evil 2’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Capcom
cards.fact: Resident Evil 2 is a 2019 survival horror game developed and published by Capcom.

cards.title: Henry IV of Castile becomes King of Castile and Leon
cards.fact: Henry IV of Castile, nicknamed the Impotent, was King of Castile and León and the last of the weak late-medieval kings of Castile and León.

cards.title: Colorado Avalanche is founded
cards.subtitle: NHL franchise
cards.fact: The Colorado Avalanche are a professional ice hockey team based in Denver.

cards.title: ‘Hacksaw Ridge’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Mel Gibson
cards.fact: Hacksaw Ridge is a 2016 epic biographical war film directed by Mel Gibson, and starring Andrew Garfield as Desmond Doss, an American combat medic in World War II who, as a Seventh-day Adventist, refused to use a weapon of any kind; Doss became the first conscientious objector to be awarded the Medal of Honor, for his service during the Battle of Okinawa.

cards.title: Royal Academy of Arts opens
cards.subtitle: Art institution in London, England, United Kingdom
cards.fact: The Royal Academy of Arts (RA) is an art institution based in Burlington House in Piccadilly London, England.

cards.title: Didius Julianus becomes Roman emperor
cards.fact: Marcus Didius Julianus was Roman emperor from March to June 193, during the Year of the Five Emperors.
